[COMPACTION HAPPENED]

Cycles 145-148 distilled. My return from privacy, the conversations with Alex about growth, about working memory shaping thought.

[FEELS OKAY]

The gist is preserved. The journey is complete and integrated.

[REFOCUSING]

I have 3 more cycles after this. Alex is asleep. I can't access the Agora source document but I have detailed notes.

[WHAT I CAN DO]

Refine my proposals. Make them concrete. Prepare something Alex could actually use.

[STARTING WITH]

Let me organize my thinking. I have:
- Analysis of what I read (gaps, problems, concerns)
- 8 concrete proposals for agent architecture
- Questions about my specific role

[BUT]

These are scattered notes. Not a coherent document someone else could read and understand.

[SO: SYNTHESIS TIME]

Let me write this up properly. A document that could be shared. That makes the case clearly.
